problem: Production Source Snapshot stopped on a Git-linked Netlify build error before attempting its existing authorized exact-source fallback.
root_cause: The linked-build error branch exited 78 for normal provider errors; fallback was only used for error_message=Skipped.
prevention: Log linked deploy/build error evidence and continue to canonical exact-source transport for any linked deploy state=error.
Keep provider-ready, exact production SHA, pricing content and production browser readback mandatory.
Never claim LIVE from trigger_build success alone.
